name: docedit
description: Oakqueill PDF Editor for iPhone and iPad: core, the shared renderer and a SwiftUI shell.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.build:ios-web: npm run build -w @docedit/core && npm run build -w @docedit/ios-web
scripts.ios:sim: npm run build:ios-web && xcodebuild -project apps/ios/Oakqueill.xcodeproj -scheme Oakqueill -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath apps/ios/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
